answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that signs a fresh per-epoch proof, and let standing rise only as already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work — trust accruing slow as a rising tide and hardening into weight as rare as ivory. A fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches merely echo back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters; honest pays one anchor once, a farm pays a fresh anchor plus the full slow climb per head, cost linear in headcount.
